description: The app.json companion / `nar app --json` output (Part 6): the non-game app universe — UI frameworks (Compose annotation census, View/XML layouts, Flutter/RN presence, WebView JS-bridge surface), navigation (manifest Activity graph, Fragment census, deep-link route map), storage (SharedPreferences candidates, Room/SQLite with shipped databases parsed read-only from sqlite_master, DataStore, asset inventory), encrypted storage (detection only), auth (OAuth markers, token storage LOCATIONS only, JWT structure only — alg + claim names, values redacted everywhere), background work, permissions declared vs code-referenced with the over-request report and its stated scan limits, named SDK inventory (versions only from shipped META-INF .version evidence), compliance surface, and an evidence-cited screen/module map + data-flow map.
title: NAR app intelligence (Part 6)
